designer-initial.summary: Selected a five-usage controller operating-mode coordinator with ten interactions, eleven closed policy cases, five scenario families, and one mode-decision owner.
questions_for_model: Can the retained SysML-AADL/GUMBO subset let PART-05 publish PART-04's applied next-mode decision in the same logical evaluation without an unintended one-cycle delay? If not, identify the exact realizability limitation without changing the case semantics.

diversity.selected_primary_scope: Controller operating-mode coordination for finite start, on, off, maintenance, degraded, and return-to-normal indications
diversity.closest_baseline: Vehicle Start-Readiness and Recovery Supervisor (replicate 1 medium)
diversity.why_not_extension_or_rename: The selected coordinator owns only controller mode sequencing and a coordination result from two indication channels. It removes brake, temperature/health, self-test, power, readiness, authorization, and actuation responsibilities; uses one mode state with a dual-qualification/compatibility/arbitration topology; gives invalid indication evidence explicit top priority; and recovers only to Off before later fresh Start and On events. Those changes replace the closest baseline's controlled purpose and policy rather than extending, repartitioning, or renaming it.

model-review.summary: All five owners are nonidentity, same-evaluation framing is realizable as an abstract relation, and the exact 5/10/11/5 allocation can proceed unchanged.

findings.evidence: PART-01 and PART-02 each map eight event/status values with fibers 4/1/1/1/1 because invalid status suppresses all four payloads. Both derive validity-aware applicability facts rather than one-to-one enum or code renames.

PART-03 maps all 25 assessment pairs with fibers 9/1/3/3/3/4/2, while PART-04 maps 875 assessment/class/pre-mode tuples through consistency, strict priority, and state-dependent transition policy. Both are substantive local classification or decision owners, and PART-04 remains the sole state and principal decision owner.

PART-05's ControllerModeDisposition projection is uncredited, but its eleven DecisionReason values map non-bijectively to CoordinationResult fibers 1/6/1/3. The public Applied/Stable/Rejected/EvidenceFault distinction is a baseline-required owner-local classification, not record bundling or a code rename.

Trusted Isolette forms and a fresh current Sireum check support local state, In(pre-state), post-state/output equality, record-valued DataPort flows, and downstream classification. The directly analogous accepted Factory Dispatch source exited 0 with Well-formed against library revision 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1.
findings.requested_change: No Designer allocation change; PART-04 must use In(controllerMode) only for pre-mode guards, constrain post-state and ModeDecision.nextMode to the same selected value, and send that applied decision over INT-08 for PART-05's local OUT-01 mapping. Preserve the non-executable timing claim boundary.

findings.evidence: Four boundary interactions require eight generated-support delegation declarations and the six internal interactions require six sibling-Thread declarations, giving exactly 14 raw PortConnection declarations, one support Process, five semantic Threads, physical depth two, ten semantic interactions, and one connected region.
findings.requested_change: No Designer allocation change; give the Process and boundary delegations no owner or semantic credit, declare all GUMBO-inspected record fields as attributes, encode explicit higher-priority exclusions, and directly analyze owner-local spaces 8/8/25/875/55 plus all 320 composed snapshots.

designer-resolution.summary: Model findings accepted as compatible with the unchanged 5/10/11/5 baseline; generation authorized.

model-generation.summary: The retained architecture and final SysML gates passed with Well-formed!, and exhaustive owner-local, 320-snapshot composition, malformed-class, scenario, ownership, count, and trace audits passed without changing Designer intent.

visualization.summary: Validated collision-free overview exported; all 93 trace associations passed audit.

designer-final.summary: Canonical source, bounded semantics, ownership, traceability, and rendered overview pass without Designer-intent drift; execution remains not-run.
